title: Show HN: I built a new version of my fun spatial 3D online meeting app
summary: A spatial 3D online meeting app for remote teams that uses web multiplayer game architecture, featuring customizable virtual spaces with interactive activities like surfing, built with Three.js for 3D rendering and LiveKit for real-time communication.
problem_solved: Makes remote team meetings more engaging and fun by creating an immersive 3D social environment instead of flat video calls
why_valuable: Provides a gamified alternative to traditional video conferencing that enhances social presence and team bonding through spatial interactions and activities
